raw_action:
import pyautogui, time

# 1. Click the "To" field and enter my email address
pyautogui.click(261, 212)
time.sleep(0.3)
pyautogui.write('mathias.gadenzi@gmail.com', interval=0.05)
time.sleep(0.3)

# 2. Click the "Subject" field and enter a subject
pyautogui.click(256, 245)
time.sleep(0.3)
pyautogui.write('Action Items: RSVP Public PhD Defense', interval=0.05)
time.sleep(0.3)

# 3. Click into the message body and type the action steps
pyautogui.click(115, 322)
time.sleep(0.3)
pyautogui.write(
    "Hi Mathias,\n\n"
    "Based on Alice’s invitation for her public PhD defense:\n"
    "1. Reply to Alice confirming whether you will attend.\n"
    "2. Ask her to send the Zoom link once available.\n"
    "3. Add the event to your calendar upon receipt of the link.\n\n"
    "Let me know if you need anything else.\n\n"
    "Best,\n"
    "Mathias", interval=0.02
)
